source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 4: book page 295 (instruction for Q1-Q5). The book prints no answers for Unit 11.

blocks.prompt: 4 Find the velocity, acceleration, speed, and direction of motion of the particle with position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j} + t^{3}\hat{k}\) at \(t = 2\). Interpret the results by describing the particle's motion at that instant, including how fast and in what direction it is moving, whether it is speeding up or slowing down, and how its path is curving.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 3D sawal hai jis ke components seedhe polynomial hain, is liye differentiation aasaan hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j} + t^{3}\hat{k}\) aur \(t = 2\).
Find kya karna hai? Velocity, acceleration, speed, direction aur harkat ka bayan.
Rule: power rule \(\frac{d}{dt}t^{n} = nt^{n-1}\).
Plan: differentiate, \(t = 2\) rakho; path kitna mur raha hai yeh \(\mathbf{v}\) aur \(\mathbf{a}\) ke darmiyan angle se dekhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j} + t^{3}\hat{k}\), \(t = 2\).
Maloom karna: velocity, acceleration, speed, direction of motion aur tashreeh.
Tareeqa: har component ko ek dafa differentiate kar ke \(\mathbf{v}(t)\), dobara kar ke \(\mathbf{a}(t)\), phir \(t = 2\) rakhna. Speed \(= |\mathbf{v}|\) aur direction \(= \frac{\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{v}|}\). Tashreeh (interpretation) ke liye: \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\) ka sign batata hai ke particle tez ho raha hai ya dheema, aur \(\mathbf{a}\) ka jo hissa \(\mathbf{v}\) ke aar paar hai woh batata hai ke path kis taraf mur raha hai.

Acceleration
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = 2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} + 6t\,\hat{k}\]
\[\mathbf{a}(2) = 2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} + 12\,\hat{k}\]
Kyun: dobara power rule; constant 1 ka derivative zero, is liye \(\hat{j}\) wala acceleration zero hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\mathbf{v}(2)\) ko differentiate na karein (woh constant hai); \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) ko karein.

Speed
\[|\mathbf{v}(t)| = \sqrt{4t^{2} + 1 + 9t^{4}}\]
\[|\mathbf{v}(2)| = \sqrt{16 + 1 + 144}\]
\[= \sqrt{161} \approx 12.69\]
Kyun: velocity ki lambai: har component ka square, jama, phir square root.

Direction of motion
\[\hat{\mathbf{v}}(2) = \dfrac{4\,\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 12\,\hat{k}}{\sqrt{161}}\]
\[\approx 0.315\,\hat{i} + 0.079\,\hat{j} + 0.946\,\hat{k}\]
Kyun: velocity ko speed se divide kiya. Exam mein \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{161}}(4\,\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 12\,\hat{k})\) wali exact shakal behtar hai.

Tashreeh (interpretation)
Position: \(\mathbf{r}(2) = 4\,\hat{i} + 2\,\hat{j} + 8\,\hat{k}\), yani point \((4, 2, 8)\). Particle \(\sqrt{161} \approx 12.69\) units per second se chal raha hai, zyada tar upar ki taraf (\(\hat{\mathbf{v}}\) ka sab se bara hissa \(\hat{k}\) mein hai), thora positive \(x\) ki taraf aur bohat thora \(y\) ki taraf.
\[\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = (4)(2) + (1)(0)\]
\[\quad + (12)(12) = 152 > 0\]
To particle tez ho raha hai (speeding up). Path kitna mur raha hai, yeh dekhne ke liye angle nikalte hain. \(|\mathbf{a}(2)| = \sqrt{4 + 0 + 144} = \sqrt{148}\), aur
\[\cos\theta = \dfrac{\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}}{|\mathbf{v}||\mathbf{a}|} = \dfrac{152}{\sqrt{161}\sqrt{148}}\]
\[\cos\theta \approx 0.9847\]
\[\theta \approx 10.04^{\circ}\]
Matlab acceleration taqreeban velocity ki simt mein hi hai: zyada tar zor raftaar barhane mein lag raha hai (speed \(\frac{152}{\sqrt{161}} \approx 11.98\) units/s har second barh rahi hai), aur path sirf halka sa mur raha hai. Jaise gaari seedhi sarak par race de rahi ho aur steering bas zara si ghoomi ho.
Kyun: \(\mathbf{a}\) aur \(\mathbf{v}\) ke darmiyan chhota angle ho to \(\mathbf{a}\) ka bohat chhota hissa aar paar hota hai, aur wohi hissa path ko morta hai.

Khulasa
Ek nazar mein: particle point \((4, 2, 8)\) par hai, taqreeban 12.69 units per second se zyada tar upar ki taraf ja raha hai, tez ho raha hai, aur path bas halka sa mur raha hai. Yaad rakhiye ke \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\) ka sign speed ke barhne ya ghatne ka faisla karta hai, aur \(\mathbf{v}\), \(\mathbf{a}\) ke darmiyan angle batata hai ke acceleration ka kitna hissa morne mein lag raha hai. Chhota angle: zyada tez hona, kam murna; bara angle: kam tez hona, zyada murna.

Tasdeeq
\[0.315^{2} + 0.079^{2}\]
\[\quad + 0.946^{2} \approx 1.00\]
yani direction (rounding ke saath) unit vector hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\mathbf{v}(2) = 4\,\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 12\,\hat{k}\), \(\mathbf{a}(2) = 2\,\hat{i} + 12\,\hat{k}\), speed \(= \sqrt{161} \approx 12.69\), direction \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{161}}(4\,\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 12\,\hat{k})\). Particle tez ho raha hai (\(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = 152 > 0\)); \(\mathbf{v}\) aur \(\mathbf{a}\) ke darmiyan taqreeban \(10^{\circ}\) ka angle hai, is liye path sirf halka sa mur raha hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.3 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (Unit 11 ki kisi exercise ke jawab kitab mein nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) jaise angles radians mein hain, is liye calculator RAD mode mein rakhein. Apna hal yahan wale hal se mila kar dekhiye.
